findings: D1 Transport (approve lsp-server-0.10.0-Message-read-write): In public-dependencies/source/lsp-server-0.10.0/src/msg.rs (lines 18-32, 207-297), Message::read(&mut impl BufRead) -> io::Result<Option<Message>> and Message::write(&self, &mut impl Write) -> io::Result<()> are public synchronous APIs that frame Content-Length / Content-Type headers (\r\n\r\n) and deserialize/serialize JSON-RPC 2.0 Request, Response, and Notification envelopes with RequestId (i32 or String) and ErrorCode (MethodNotFound = -32601, ServerNotInitialized = -32002, InvalidRequest = -32600). Using Message::read and Message::write on locked stdin/stdout avoids the 3-thread + bounded(0) crossbeam channel graph in Connection::stdio (src/stdio.rs:14-60) and the hardcoded timeouts / omitted serverInfo in Connection::initialize (src/lib.rs:104-169), while avoiding duplicate framing code from manual-existing-serde-json-framing. Note that the published lsp-server-0.10.0 archive (Cargo.toml) declares only crossbeam-channel 0.5.15, log 0.4.27, serde 1.0.219, serde_derive 1.0.219, and serde_json 1.0.140 (no rustc-hash dependency, unlike upstream rust-analyzer master).

D2 Types (approve gen-lsp-types-0.11.0-no-features-3.17-subset): In public-dependencies/source/gen-lsp-types-0.11.0/Cargo.toml, setting default-features = false disables optional url and fluent-uri dependencies, leaving only serde and serde_json (both edition 2024, matching source/Cargo.toml), whereas lsp-types 0.97.0 (edition 2018) pulls bitflags 1.0.1 (alongside existing Cargo.lock bitflags 2.13.2), fluent-uri 0.1.4, and serde_repr 0.1. Without url/fluent-uri, gen-lsp-types defines pub struct Uri(pub String) (src/generated/common.rs:28), which transparently accepts in-memory editor URIs like untitled:invoice.mori without URI parser rejection. Although gen-lsp-types 0.11.0 is generated from the LSP 3.18 metamodel where Diagnostic.message has type Message (src/generated/structures.rs:6295, src/generated/enum_ors.rs:1184, #[serde(untagged)] enum Message { String(String), MarkupContent(MarkupContent) }), constructing Message::String(...) (or From<String>) emits a plain JSON string on the wire, and ServerCapabilities, TextDocumentSync::Options(TextDocumentSyncOptions { open_close: Some(true), change: Some(TextDocumentSyncKind::Full), ..Default::default() }), PositionEncodingKind::UTF16, InitializeResult, ServerInfo, PublishDiagnosticsParams (with skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none on version), and DiagnosticSeverity serialize identically to the LSP 3.17 subset in PROPOSED-EXPECTED-SESSION.json.

D3 Profile Scope (approve same-routing-as-current-Rust-check): Routing in-memory document text identically to source/crates/mori/src/commands/check.rs (lines 29-39) via mori_lexer::first_token_text(&source).is_ok_and(|t| t == "language") and mori_core::language(&source) (source/crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs:366-407) invokes mori_core::stage::load(&source) for "moriarty/2" (source/crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:73-90: parse_v2, require_core2, validate_v2, plan::build, plan_invariants, cost::fill, cost_invariants, program_hash, plan_hash), mori_core::parse(&source) for other language-prefixed sources (parser.rs:4-175, calling runtime::validate(&parser.program) in runtime.rs:120-250 without invoking runtime::simulate), and mori_parser::parse(&source) followed by mori_checker::check(&ast) for beta sources. Both fixtures/core1-normal.mori and fixtures/core2-normal.mori declare agreement Minimal { action tick() {} }, satisfying !program.actions.is_empty() in runtime::validate and stage::load and producing diagnostics: [] in PROPOSED-EXPECTED-SESSION.json. Advertising experimental.moriarty { analysis: "local-check-only", sourceProfiles: ["moriarty-beta/1", "moriarty/1", "moriarty/2"] } and tagging Diagnostic.source as "moriarty-rust (<profile>)" satisfies UNI-018 and UNI-024 without overclaiming compiler/proof/ledger or MCP capabilities. (Implementation note: when mori_core::parse fails before or during header parsing on a language-prefixed file where mori_core::language(&source) is not "moriarty/2", Diagnostic.source should deterministically use "moriarty-rust (moriarty/1)".)

D4 Lifecycle, Capabilities, and State Ordering: The proposed lifecycle (initialize -> initialized -> didOpen/didChange/didClose -> shutdown -> exit) and error handling (-32002 ServerNotInitialized before initialize, -32600 InvalidRequest for duplicate initialize or post-shutdown requests, -32601 MethodNotFound for unsupported requests like textDocument/hover, and no response envelopes for notifications) match LSP 3.17 and lsp-server 0.10.0 ErrorCode constants. Keying in-memory document state by opaque Uri, requiring strictly increasing version numbers on didChange to prevent stale overwrites, and omitting version (version: None) when clearing diagnostics on didClose match PROPOSED-INPUT-SESSION.json and PROPOSED-EXPECTED-SESSION.json. Furthermore, exercising the actual compiled mori lsp binary over stdio in an integration test is grounded in RUST_GUIDELINES.md and source/crates/mori/src/main.rs -> commands::lsp::run().

D5 Diagnostic Projection and UTF-16 Oracle Coherence: Mapping MoriDiagnostic (source/crates/mori-diagnostics/src/diagnostic.rs:28-117, source/crates/mori/src/json.rs:155-184) by selecting labels.iter().find(|l| l.primary).or_else(|| labels.first()), projecting remaining non-empty labels to relatedInformation at the same document Uri, appending help after "

", and mapping Severity::{Error, None} -> 1, Warning -> 2, Advice -> 3 preserves full diagnostic fidelity. For fixtures/beta-edit-before.mori, line 2 ("  /* 🧪 */ const total = shipping + 1;
") begins at UTF-8 byte offset 47; "  /* " is 5 bytes (5 UTF-16 units), "🧪" (U+1F9EA) is 4 UTF-8 bytes and 2 UTF-16 code units (surrogate pair), and " */ const total = " is 18 bytes (18 UTF-16 units), placing "shipping" at UTF-8 bytes 74..82 (column 27 in 1-indexed bytes) and 0-indexed UTF-16 range line 2, character 25..33, with code "mori::check::unknown_name" and message "I cannot find a declaration named `shipping`.

Declare `shipping` above this line. A declaration can only use the names declared above it." (verified against source/crates/mori-checker/src/diagnostics.rs:6-24). Mapping mori_core::Error { code, message, offset } (source/crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:468-482) to a zero-width UTF-16 range at offset.unwrap_or(0) avoids fabricating token end spans while GH-I82 remains open.
limitations: No Cargo resolver, Cargo.lock update, rustc compilation, or test execution was performed in this read-only review; lsp-server 0.10.0 and gen-lsp-types 0.11.0 are verified against their pinned crate archives and metadata in public-dependencies/, not yet resolved in source/Cargo.lock. Exact pending lock/source checks at implementation admission: (1) verify cargo metadata / Cargo.lock resolution with workspace dependencies lsp-server = "0.10.0" and lsp-types = { package = "gen-lsp-types", version = "0.11.0", default-features = false } adds only the expected crate graph (lsp-server 0.10.0, gen-lsp-types 0.11.0, crossbeam-channel 0.5.15, crossbeam-utils, log 0.4.27) and does not activate url or fluent-uri; (2) verify cargo test -p mori compiles and passes the real mori lsp binary integration oracle over PROPOSED-INPUT-SESSION.json -> PROPOSED-EXPECTED-SESSION.json.

No security, resource-cap, or hostile-input judgment is made in this ordinary protocol/library review; those judgments and hostile tests belong exclusively to the designated security review owner. Mechanical source exposures identified for the designated security owner: (1) public-dependencies/source/lsp-server-0.10.0/src/msg.rs:235-285 reads headers via BufRead::read_line in a loop until empty line and parses Content-Length: <usize> followed by vec![0; size] allocation and read_exact(&mut buf) without an internal library cap on header line length, header count, or Content-Length byte size; (2) serde_json deserialization of untrusted JSON-RPC payloads and full-sync document text allocations in memory per open Uri; (3) synchronous analysis execution on the main loop thread where mori_parser / mori_checker / mori_core::parse (which enforces MAX_TOKENS = 16,384, MAX_EXPRESSIONS = 8,192, expression nesting <= 64 in parser.rs:148-150, 259-269) / mori_core::stage::load run per didOpen/didChange event.
